# Second Island cliff and shrub

ChalkBluff.glb is derived from Poly Haven's Mountainside scan. It uses the 1K source maps, reduced geometry and a chalk-lavender color grade. [Mountainside](https://polyhaven.com/a/mountainside)

HighlandShrub.glb is derived from Poly Haven's Shrub 01. It uses the 1K maps and a reduced mesh. [Shrub 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/shrub_01)

Poly Haven provides both original models and textures under CC0. The Blender working copies are in `ArtSource/ModelRefinement/Island2`. [Poly Haven license](https://polyhaven.com/license)
